MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The digital caliper felt useful because it would help me measure and match the small screws and locking washers I recently bought.",
    "It connected my recent purchases through a practical task: checking hardware dimensions before choosing a compatible part."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The imperial bolts did not feel like a natural addition to my metric screw assortment; similar-looking fasteners still need to fit the same dimensions and threads.",
    "Wire insulation and waterproof connectors assumed a wiring project from my electronics screws, while my purchases only showed a need for fastening parts.",
    "The farm jack, plumbing valves, clock oil, and decking tape required specific projects I do not currently have.",
    "The mini fridge missed why I bought magnetic hooks: I wanted to hang items on a magnetic surface, not buy another refrigerator."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying a few hardware supplies seemed to be treated as interest in almost any workshop, repair, or construction product.",
    "Words such as electronics and refrigerator seemed to carry more weight than the actual purpose of the screws and hooks I chose.",
    "My hand truck purchase seemed to imply a need for other heavy lifting equipment, despite their different uses."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases concentrated on small fasteners and magnetic hanging supplies, making precise fit and practical compatibility especially relevant.",
    "Several purchases happened close together, which suggests a related set of immediate tasks more than a broad interest in unrelated repair projects.",
    "I rarely choose something without a clear use, so large rolls and multipacks felt unhelpful when there was no matching project in my recent activity."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical hardware but often missed the specific fastening, measuring, and hanging tasks behind my choices."
}
